净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Volatility-adjusted price impact using a longer-term volatility estimate (40-day rolling std) to provide a more stable risk adjustment. This reduces noise in the factor and improves cross-sectional ranking consistency while preserving the core liquidity/impact intuition. The 20-day impact window captures recent market microstructure, while the 40-day volatility window captures persistent risk.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

rolling_20_mean(|ret|/vol) / rolling_40_std(ret)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(divide(ts_mean(divide(abs(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1)), Volume), 20), ts_std(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 40)), 0)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_mean(divide(abs(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1)), Volume), 20), ts_std(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 40))
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(abs(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1)), Volume), 20)
  4. 4. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(abs(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1)), Volume)
  5. 5. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1))
  6. 6. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1)
  7. 7. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  8. 8. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  9. 9. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 40)
  10. 10. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1)
  11. 11. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  12. 12. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用
Volume成交量当日成交量（股数），反映参与度

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 ret：close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
  4. 计算 abs_ret：ret.abs()
  5. 计算 impact：abs_ret / volume
  6. 计算 avg_impact：impact.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  7. 计算 vol：ret.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=40).std(ddof=1)
  8. 计算 factor：avg_impact / vol
  9. 计算 factor：factor

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_price_impact_vol_adj_stable_vol(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0 abs_ret = ret.abs() "com"># Price impact per unit volume impact = abs_ret / volume.replace(0, np.nan) avg_impact = impact.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() "com"># Longer-term volatility "kw">class="kw">for stability vol = ret.rolling(40, min_periods=40).std(ddof=1).replace(0, np.nan) factor = avg_impact / vol factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_vol_adj_stable_vol'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_vol_adj_stable_vol']
